props.name: autoFocus
props.description:
Whether the textarea is focused after mounting, by script rather than the native `autofocus`
attribute. Focus is skipped when the textarea is disabled, and `autoFocusDelay` postpones it.

props.name: autoFocusDelay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds between mount and focusing the textarea. Only used with `autoFocus`.

props.name: autoResize
props.description:
Whether the height grows with the content. The textarea shows at least `rows` rows and, when
`maxRows` is set, at most `maxRows` rows before it scrolls. Overflow is hidden while it fits.

props.name: autoResizeDelay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before the first autoresize after mount. Later resizes run without it. Only used with `autoResize`.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial value for uncontrolled usage; `null` starts empty. Also the value restored when the
owning form is reset.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's main focusable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to
with `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's related parts (hidden
input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it unique on the page.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Native `maxlength`: the maximum number of characters the user can type. Numeric strings are accepted.

props.name: maxRows
props.description:
Maximum number of rows the textarea grows to with `autoResize`; longer content scrolls.
`0` means unlimited. Ignored without `autoResize`.

props.name: modifiers
props.description:
Transforms the text before it reaches `onValueChange` and form state, and sets the callback's
value type.

- `trim`: strips surrounding whitespace, also from the displayed text on `change` (blur).
- `lazy`: updates the value on `change` instead of on every keystroke.
- `number`: parses the text to a `number`; empty or non-numeric text gives `null`.
- `empty`: `'null'` turns an empty (whitespace-only) string into `null`; `'preserve'` keeps the string.
examples:
import { Textarea } from 'moraine'

<Textarea
  modifiers={{ trim: true, lazy: true, empty: 'null' }}
  onValueChange={(note) => console.log(note)} // string | null, once per blur
/>

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Native blur event handler.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change event, after value synchronization and Field notification.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Native focus event handler.

props.name: onInput
props.description: Native `input` event handler, called after the component has handled the event. It fires on every keystroke, also with `modifiers.lazy`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the new value, after `modifiers` are applied, as the user edits. It fires on
every keystroke, or on `change` (blur) with `modifiers.lazy`. Its argument type follows
`modifiers`: `string` by default, `number | null` with `number`, and `string | null` with
`empty: 'null'`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint text shown while the textarea is empty. It is not a substitute for a label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref callback or variable that receives the native `<textarea>` element.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: rows
props.description: Number of visible text rows. With `autoResize` it is the minimum height in rows.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description:
The current value (controlled). `undefined` leaves the textarea uncontrolled and `null` is a
controlled empty value; the displayed text is restored to this value after every edit, so
update it from `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.
